verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say it can 'implement entirely new features' and take on complex delegated tasks that yield a first draft (devin-docs-1, devin-docs-5), and Auto-Fix iterates on review comments and CI failures (devin-docs-20). Nothing in the evidence explicitly says Devin writes tests as part of feature work, and community reports of a 13.8% issue-resolution rate and a demo that missed its job requirements temper confidence in end-to-end delivery (devin-comm-2, devin-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Devin authors tests for the features it implements, hands-on evidence of successful end-to-end feature delivery, and independent corroboration beyond vendor claims.
